text:
Situation: Lidocaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2012-02-22 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Multiple manufacturers are listed, including Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, and Hospira Inc. Corvale East, General, and Lakeside sites use Hikma 20 mg/mL 50 mL vials (NDC 0143-9575-10) from Hikma Farmacêutica Portugal and Fresenius Kabi 10 mg/mL 10 mL vials (NDC 63323-482-17) from Fresenius Kabi Austria and Fresenius Kabi USA LLC plants. Corvale East holds 357 vials of 20 mg/mL 50 mL (18.9 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 15 vials (3.9 days). Corvale General holds approximately 129-135 vials across entries (6 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2012-02-22; status is Current as of 2026-10-21. FDA inspected the Fresenius Kabi Austria plant (FEI 3003708554) on 2024-03-21 (VAI). FDA inspected the Fresenius Kabi USA LLC plant (FEI 3001833549) on 2023-10-13 (VAI). FDA inspected the Hospira Inc. plant (FEI 1021343) on 2025-02-07 (NAI). FDA inspection 732886 at Hospira Inc. ended 2011-06-17 (OAI), 250 days before the shortage posting.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at Lakeside (3.9 days) and low at General (6 days). East has sufficient stock to support internal transfers while maintaining at least two weeks on hand for key presentations. No clinical substitutions are proposed; therapeutic alternatives remain a committee decision.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 40 vials of 20 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 52 vials of 20 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Transfer 9 vials of 10 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
4. Transfer 14 vials of 5 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
5. Transfer 30 vials of 5 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.

Not recommended: Purchasing additional stock from listed manufacturers at this time; current allocation limits and the long-standing shortage status suggest limited availability. Initiating clinical protocol changes without committee review.
